## 维护者速读

- 在工作室里把对象扩展先存草稿、再单项发布的作者:以前货币字段指向不成立时发布照样成功,之后每次写入都被拒;现在发布当场拒绝并给出与直接保存相同的提示,草稿保持为草稿。

- 出错时最坏是某个本应能发布的扩展被拒;只影响单项发布,撤回本改动即可恢复原行为。
- 无。

## What changes

`promoteDraftForPublish` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`) now asks the registry's record-currency follow door for an `object_extension` draft on the per-item publish (`POST /api/v1/meta/object_extension/NAME/publish`, the against-registry question), with exactly the call the published save asks in `protocol-save.ts` (the ADR-0144 D2/D6-amended, #33593 ruling R1 block): `registry.objectRegistrationRefusal({ ...contribution, name: extend }, promoteInto, 'extend', { againstRegistry: true })`, the body read through `registrableObjectExtension`. The refusal is thrown before `repo.promoteDraft` writes, so the answer is the registry's own `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the save door's sentence and the draft stays a draft. `publishPackageDrafts` is unchanged (it states `body-only` and is never reached by the new block); measured below, it already refused both shapes.

Also: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains three generated rows (from `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`) for the new test file's pinned engine doubles. This is outside the claim's declared file surface; it is the generated consequence of the new test file the claim names, and nothing else in the ledger moved.

## Why

Measured before the fix (commit `eca20d22`, real kernel + real `SchemaRegistry` + real protocol, in-memory driver: the rig of `packages/objectql/src/protocol-batch-object-registration.test.ts`, calling `publishMetaItem`, the method the REST route calls). A package `com.qa.mz` with `mz_invoice` (`title` text, `currency_code` text holding an ISO 4217 code) and `mz_line` (`invoice` master_detail to `mz_invoice`); each draft adds a record-mode amount `fee`:

| Draft pointer | Published save | Draft save | Per-item publish (before) | First write of `fee` (before) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `zz_missing` on `mz_invoice` (one segment) | 422 `INVALID_METADATA` | ok | `success: true`, promoted, registered | 400 `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` |
| `invoice.title` on `mz_line` (pair (a)) | 422 `INVALID_METADATA` | ok | `success: true`, promoted, registered | **written**, with `title` read as the currency |
| `invoice.nothing` on `mz_line` (pair (a)) | 422 `INVALID_METADATA` | ok | `success: true`, promoted, registered | 400 `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` |
| `currency_code` / `invoice.currency_code` (controls) | ok | ok | `success: true` | ok |

`publishPackageDrafts` of the same drafts answered `outcome: 'refused'` with the refused row in `failed[]` (code `INVALID_METADATA`) and promoted nothing, so the batch door has no such hole.

After the fix, the same rig: each refused shape's per-item publish answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the byte-identical message the published save answers, no active row, the draft row still there, and the amount is not served (a write naming `fee` answers `400 INVALID_FIELD`). Both controls still publish and write.

Metadata-protocol `none`: nothing an author can save changes. The published save already refused these bodies; only the per-item publish of a draft (which the draft save accepts, body-only, as before) now refuses them, matching that save.

## Tests

- New `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.extension-publish-follow-door-35566.test.ts` (4 cases): for both shapes, the draft save answers 200, the per-item publish is refused `422 INVALID_METADATA` (`RecordCurrencyFollowRefusedError`) with the message the published save answers for the same body, the draft stays a draft with no active row, and the question asked is the save door's (target as `name`, no `extend`/`priority`, the package promoted into, `'extend'`, `againstRegistry: true`); CONTROL: a one-segment and a master_detail-led pointer the served object satisfies publish and are promoted. The registry there is a double that records the question and judges a pointer against the objects it serves (this package cannot import `@objectstack/objectql`); the real registry's judgement of the same shapes is the measurement above and the existing save-door pins in `packages/objectql/src/protocol-batch-object-registration.test.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (three generated rows) is a declared file-surface addition, explained above.
- The published-save follow-door call in `protocol-save.ts` and the new one here are two spellings of one question; folding them into one helper in `protocol-object-extension-item.ts` would touch files outside this card's surface (and `protocol-save.ts` is held for the next card in series), so it is left as is.

## Verification
